milestone: Alpha 2.5.1: no Dynamax or Gigantamax gameplay
changes: B_DYNAMAX_ENABLED is FALSE in the production profile
CanDynamax returns FALSE before player/trainer eligibility checks
ActivateDynamax returns without changing battle state when disabled
Upstream mechanics tests explicitly enable their test-only configuration; Complete Edition regressions force the shipped disabled policy
map_validation: 84 placements; 61 graphics; 24 leaders; 12 starters; 29 legendary trails and acyclic gates

existing_save_reload.method: fresh mGBA process; ordinary Continue and button movement; no emulator state or injected progress

scope: Dynamax and Gigantamax cannot be activated by players or trainers in the shipped build. Shared IDs, save fields and HP cleanup routines remain intact.
Other experimental battle repairs were excluded after a broad WIP audit found regressions. They are not part of this ROM.
This patch reruns focused native and existing-save checks; it does not replace the previous full audit. Main-story, Frontier, portraits and hardware release QA remain open.
